messages:
Mina: FYI OrionCloud shipment for EU racks hit customs hold. ETA slipping ~10-14 days. Affects reserved Dedicated capacity in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1.

Oliver: ugh. Which customers are at risk? any embargoed/on-prem that can't move?

Kevin (OrionCloud): Sorry—customs flagged a paperwork mismatch. Working manifests + expedited broker. Current ETA estimate 11 days, could be 7-14. We will push daily status and try airfreight.

warehouse-bot: Manifest update: container 7C -> status=HOLD; expected_release=2024-09-10 (est). Tracking: https://logi.example/7C

Sanjay: Prioritization ask: can we shift some reserved pools to marketplace burst or swap to us-west temporarily? Also need list of customers who require EU-only (GDPR/compliance).

Lisa: I'll run quick impact matrix. My plan: (1) identify EU-only tenants (2) offer burst credits + traffic shaping for mid-tier (3) for top enterprise, propose temporary private VLAN in us-west with contractual exception. will ping sales.

Mina: @Kevin (OrionCloud) can you confirm which racks can be split (not full-data-center), i.e. partial shipment? partial arrivals let us serve canaries.

Kevin (OrionCloud): We can split 4/10 racks now, ship by air in 4 days. Remaining 6 via sea in ~12 days. Will send manifest by EOD.

Sanjay: ok — if 4 racks airfreight -> how many GPUs & what capacity. Need mapping to reservation IDs. @Mina can you create mapping table, or I'll run script.

Mina: creating mapping now. Pushing CSV to shared drive and I'll post link here when done.

Oliver: Also flagging ops: update rollout windows and autoscale policies to avoid oversubscription in eu regions.

Lisa: Noted. I'll update rollout policy: add fallback_route=us-west, and set autoscale ceiling +10% until capacity stabilizes.

Mina: Thanks all. Action items: Kevin send manifest by EOD; Mina post mapping + affected reservation IDs; Lisa update rollout & sales play; Sanjay coordinate on temporary swap script. We'll reconvene tomorrow 09:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
